entries.title: A crewmate can post a reply you already allowed, with no card
entries.body: A task that would wait for your click to reply on your project, such as a comment on an issue, now posts the reply once with no card if a yes of yours still covers it: a direction you gave for that project, a yes on one of its cards, or words you gave for the task. Its Activity quotes the words it rested on. A crewmate that reads words anyone can write, a change to another project and an integration's actions still ask you, but a task with no project on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket can change any repository on a yes of yours. The new guide An intake round shows how to answer issues this way.
entries.noPicture: The change skips an approval card rather than adding a new screen; its one new line sits in a task's existing Activity.
